_comment: 2023 賽季導言 facts pack。每個 verified:true 的 claim 由 scripts/check-season-intros.py 內建查詢對 data/f1/db.sqlite 重查驗證；導言中每個阿拉伯數字與順位詞都必須落在本檔 verified claims 的 anchors 內。external_history 屬常識性歷史背景、不進機械對帳。

claims.source: sqlite: SELECT 1 FROM seasons WHERE year=2023
sqlite: SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE season=2023
